description: This file implements an asynchronous API for reranking documents based on relevance to a query. It contains two main functions: 'rerank' for synchronous reranking with support for multiple providers and 'arerank' for asynchronous execution. The code manages multiple external rerank providers, handles configuration, API key management, and dynamically dispatches to provider-specific rerank logic. It also includes logging and error handling tailored to different service providers such as Cohere, Azure, DeepInfra, and various proprietary or private APIs.

methods.description: Performs document reranking synchronously, supporting multiple LLM providers and configuration options. Handles provider-specific API calls, manages API keys, and executes rerank logic based on selected provider.
